title: Fee Basis by Statement Size — Utility Pass-Through Service Late Fee Schedule
content:
**Schedule provision.** For a late fee on a Utility Pass-Through Service statement, the fee basis depends on the size of the statement, meaning its usage, fixed and administration charges: a statement of 150.00 dollars or more carries a fee basis of 6 percent of those charges, rounded half up to the cent; a statement of less than 40.00 dollars carries the schedule's late fee amount times those charges divided by 40.00, rounded half up to the cent. A statement of 40.00 dollars or more but less than 150.00 dollars takes no different basis under this provision.

**The statement measured.** The statement the late fee is figured on — the statement dated one whole month before the handling date, whole months counted from the statement date to the handling date. Its size is the total of the usage charges, fixed charges and administration fee dated on that statement; adjustment credits, payments and late fees are not part of it.

## Bands

| Statement size (usage, fixed and administration charges) | Fee basis |
|---|---|
| 150.00 or more | 6 percent of the statement size, rounded half up to the cent |
| 40.00 up to but not including 150.00 | no different basis under this provision |
| less than 40.00 | schedule's late fee amount times the statement size, divided by 40.00, rounded half up to the cent |

## Worked figures (hypothetical, Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule: late fee amount 15.00)

| Statement size | Working | Fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| 212.40 | 6 percent of 212.40 is 12.744 | 12.74 |
| 150.00 | 6 percent of 150.00 | 9.00 |
| 149.99 | middle band | no different basis |
| 40.00 | middle band | no different basis |
| 32.00 | 15.00 times 32.00, divided by 40.00 | 12.00 |
| 18.75 | 15.00 times 18.75, divided by 40.00, is 7.03125 | 7.03 |
